# Pricing

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/render-pricing.mjs from https://api.mosadd.dev/v1/pricing — do not edit by hand. -->

Prepaid, no plans. The test key (`m0s_tk_test_…`) is free. A top-up of at least 10 USD unlocks the full line key (`m0s_lk_live_…`).
Every call is held before it runs and settled after it; with an empty balance the hub answers 402.
Each call is rounded up to the next micro-dollar (0.000001 USD).
Usage per call: [app.mosadd.dev](https://app.mosadd.dev) → Usage.
